concerns.text: FR-004 requires a permutation test with **n=100** label‑shuffles. The implemented task T012 (and downstream T013) performs **500** permutations, which diverges from the specification and changes the statistical power/runtime expectations.

FR-005 mandates a Kolmogorov‑Smirnov test comparing the **full unfiltered** ΔScore distribution of SNPs inside GWAS loci against the distribution of SNPs outside GWAS loci (or a matched control). Task T012 conducts the KS test against the **GC‑matched control set** only, not against the outside‑GWAS SNPs, thus not satisfying the functional requirement.
